assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a finished landscape background illustration for a light-themed anime and movie streaming website. Generate a wide 2:1 panoramic illustration. Strong unmistakable JAPANESE 2D ANIME BACKGROUND ART: exquisite hand-painted animation film still, delicate drawn contours, painterly clouds, clean cel-shaded objects, soft watercolor atmosphere, emotional storytelling. Not photorealistic, not a 3D render, not corporate architectural visualization. Daytime palette of clear powder blue, pearl white, soft lavender, with small cheerful pink and fresh green accents. Have visible confident colors and beautiful detail on the RIGHT, not a washed-out blank picture. LEFT THIRD has calm pale blue-white sky or mist for dark website headings. Subject arranged middle-right, important details in middle vertical band so image also works as a shallow banner. Wide natural depth and smooth integration from left to right, no hard division. Fits a mist-white Liquid Glass interface but do NOT draw any interface or abstract glass UI objects. No text, writing, watermarks, logos, lettering or split-screen.

Petals in sunlight, a little magical realism. Empty cinema waiting for the first showing.
